name: Amerikaner
summary: Norwegian trick-taking bidding game where the high bidder picks a hidden partner and tries to win the bid number of tricks.
rules_text: 4 players (3-5 possible) get 12 cards each from 52, 4 face-down to a kitty. Clockwise bidding starting left of dealer; minimum 6, each bid must be higher, passing is final. If all pass redeal. High bidder takes kitty unseen and discards same number face-down. If bid is a number, suit of first lead is trump and bidder calls a trump they do not hold; owner must play it to first trick and becomes bidder's partner. If bid is Amerikaner (12) there is no partner and no trump. Trick play: must follow suit if able, otherwise any card; highest trump or highest led suit wins trick, winner leads next. Scoring: bidding side needs at least bid tricks. If successful both bidder and partner score +bid, else both score -bid. Non-bidding players individually score +1 per trick won. Amerikaner bid scores +-52 for bidder alone. Cumulative first over 52 points wins, highest total wins.
